subject: 31-year-old woman in quilted sail coat
pose: 三分之二侧面，转眼看观者
art_direction: 31岁女性扎低马尾，巨大绗缝肩片像折帆，银灰与酸橙点色，侧望清醒。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Photograph an original 31-year-old woman with a low black ponytail and a clear, thoughtful face. She wears a fully enclosing silver-gray quilted coat with broad shoulder panels folded like compact sails; a lime inner seam supplies one sharp accent. Turn her torso three-quarter while both eyes remain visible to the camera. Use soft cool studio light and a warm stone background. Show stitching, compressed padding, and fabric grain, keeping the panels architectural but wearable. Avoid exposed skin beyond face and hands, fantasy armor, or excessive accessories. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
